a.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `float32`, `float64`.
constraints: a must be one of float32, float64
a, b, and x must be the same shape and type
if a <= 0 or b <= 0, I_x(a, b) = 0

b.description: A `Tensor`. Must have the same type as `a`.
constraints: b must have the same dtype as a
a, b, and x must be the same shape and type
if a <= 0 or b <= 0, I_x(a, b) = 0

x.description: A `Tensor`. Must have the same type as `a`.
constraints: x must have the same dtype as a
a, b, and x must be the same shape and type
x must be in range [0, 1] inclusive

output.description: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `a`.

constraints: a, b, and x must be the same shape and type
if a <= 0 or b <= 0, I_x(a, b) = 0
